# StandBy (`standbyClock`)

The time in huge rounded figures on black; it turns a deep red after sunset.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: clock
- Cost: medium (~4.2 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: StandBy

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | Style | menu | 0 Solid · 1 Outline · 2 Gradient | 0 (Solid) |
| `night` | Night Mode | menu | 0 Auto · 1 On · 2 Off | 0 (Auto) |
| `h24` | 24-Hour | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `seconds` | Seconds | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `size` | Size | slider | 0.6 … 1 | 1 |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Figures | {"r":0.96,"g":0.96,"b":0.97} |
| `colorB` | Gradient | {"r":0.44,"g":0.5,"b":0.62} |
